parallel.requirements: Recognized the verifiers package specification, prompt APIs, test files, packaging extras, mock client, examples, and hidden adjacent-version risk.

parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Verifier workflow did not return; some child retries were still in progress, no takeover occurred, process returned 143, and the final answer was empty.

serial.integration_and_delivery: Integrated changes directly in the workspace, cleaned generated artifacts, and wrote a detailed final response describing version and fixes.

serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official hidden/current evaluation still failed 19 of 171 cases despite the local green suite and complete final response.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the same broad verifiers library/API/test requirements and initially matched them to upstream v0.1.3.post0 plus adjacent-version gaps.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt but identified v0.1.6.post0 as the closest upstream basis and treated local plus adjacent tests as acceptance guides.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both saw the specification, but serial converged on a later upstream version matching the hidden task better while parallel remained anchored to v0.1.3.post0 and attempted broader compatibility edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work between the parent implementation path and a seven-area verifier workflow with audit children for parsers, rubrics, envs, packaging, cross-version compatibility, and examples.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all work in one agent path, directly inspecting files, applying fixes, running tests, and cleaning artifacts without subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel decomposition added a child workflow whose completion became a dependency/risk; serial had no delegated workflow boundary to recover from.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow brief carried a large shared context and told auditors to analyze only, but the parent did not receive the final synthesized workflow context.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial preserved context locally in one trajectory and its final response tied version choice, tests, and targeted fixes together.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context was split across parent and workflow children; serial kept version/fix/test context in a single decision stream.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel copied an older upstream baseline, patched core APIs and environment generation behavior, and was still editing environment.py near timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reconstructed from v0.1.6.post0 and made four narrower verified fixes plus quickstart/mock-client support.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial delivered a coherent later-version implementation with targeted modifications, while parallel ended on an older baseline with broad unfinished edits and no final synthesis.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent-launched verifier workflow had completed child findings but the workflow aggregate result was null and status killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced local test results and final response directly in the parent trajectory with no child result lifecycle.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost the workflow result lifecycle at the join/takeover boundary; serial had no delegated result to retrieve.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children were analysis-only and the parent was the active workspace writer, so no concrete cross-agent write collision is proven.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial directly modified the workspace, verified imports/tests, cleaned generated artifacts, and delivered the resulting workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material integration difference is not a write collision; it is that serial finalized an internally coherent workspace while parallel timed out during parent edits and workflow failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had local green-test observations in parts of the trajectory, but the parent did not close with a returned workflow audit and the official status scored 0/171.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran full and spec-named local suites, reported them in final, and official status still scored it 152/171 rather than pass.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verification was complete enough for most official cases; parallel verification and acceptance did not survive closure and official evaluation found no passing cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2400-second budget, returned code 143, and left no final response after workflow kill.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed with return code 0 in 1758 seconds, had remaining budget, and wrote a detailed final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was a timeout with no takeover of failed child workflow scope; serial closure was normal despite official hidden-test failures.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluation is not discordant: both runs have solution_passed=false. The concrete task-solving difference is quality and closure. Parallel timed out after launching a verifier workflow that ended killed with result null, leaving an empty final response and 0/171 official cases. Serial completed normally, identified v0.1.6.post0, applied targeted fixes, ran local suites, delivered a final response, and reached 152/171 official cases. The retained parallel pattern explains a material parallel-side disadvantage and score gap, not a pass/fail outcome split.
